_what: The limits on walking untrusted nested input (parts/bounded-walk.mjs): deeper than `max_depth` levels or more than `max_nodes` values is refused before it is rendered or stored. `words` say why, keyed by the typed reason.

words.too_deep: That is nested more than {limit} levels deep, so it was not accepted.
words.too_many_nodes: That holds more than {limit} values, so it was not accepted.
words.cycle: That refers back to itself, so it was not accepted.
